这是一次针对“关于”页面与正式发版体验的修复版本。This patch release makes update discovery and published release notes genuinely usable.

## 更新内容 / What changed

- 修复更新检查只比较版本号、却无法查看或下载新版本的问题；打开“关于”页面时会检查一次，按钮可用于重试。The About page now checks once when opened, keeps a retry action, and provides a clear route to the verified official Release page.
- “关于”页面会读取 GitHub 最新正式 Release 的版本、发布日期与更新说明，不再把客户端内写死的三条内容当成在线更新日志。The About page now reads the latest stable Release version, publication date, and notes from GitHub.
- Release 正文以安全的纯文本结构显示，并过滤旧的单行提交链接占位说明，不渲染远程 HTML。Remote release notes are rendered as safe structured text; placeholder-only commit links and remote HTML are not displayed.
- 更新检查增加十秒超时、重复点击保护、无公开版本与网络失败状态，并保留离线可读的本地说明。Update checks now handle timeouts, repeated clicks, missing releases, network failures, and an offline fallback.
- 外部下载入口仅允许打开 `GKNEETIEMAY/ProxyEnv` 的官方 GitHub Releases 路径。The external opener is restricted to this repository's official GitHub Releases path.

## 下载与验证 / Download and verification

- 大多数用户请选择 `ProxyEnv_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe`。Most users should choose the NSIS installer.
- 需要免安装版本时请选择 `ProxyEnv-0.1.1-windows-x64-portable.exe`。Use the portable executable when installation is not desired.
- 也提供 `ProxyEnv_0.1.1_x64_en-US.msi`，适合受管理的 Windows 环境。An MSI package is also included for managed Windows environments.
- 请使用随 Release 提供的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 和 GitHub Artifact Attestation 验证下载文件。Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt` and the GitHub Artifact Attestation attached to this build provenance.

ProxyEnv 按项目策略不使用 Windows Authenticode，Windows 可能显示“未知发布者”或 SmartScreen 提示。ProxyEnv intentionally does not use Windows Authenticode, so Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen warnings.
